3

Details

Cells: Huber line w = w0 + b·tan_ref. The constant part is the rigid tilt of the chamber against M3 (ws_v_w0, F9); the ramp is the bow (bow note, slide 6).

Angle scale (ladder slope = local v × scale): flat to ±3 % on det2/det3, ±10–15 % on det4/det6

Slope of the fitted w against M3 tan per 70 mm cell, divided by the chamber median

PARTLY usedone kw and one v per view; v(x, y) is FA's, the bow does not change it

4

Details

The ladder slope cannot tell a local drift velocity from a local angle scale; FA separates them (v(x, y) from the column duration and the ladder). det6 is ~10 % faster in its centre in both views, det4 Y ramps 0.82 → 1.04 along y.

Drift velocity in time: det4 falls ~10 % over its day run, det6 rises ~12 % over the night

FA's v(t) and v(x, y) calibration is PENDING; shown: ws_v_w0 time quintiles

NOT used in reconstructionone v per view and run; v(t) and v(x, y) are FA's bundle slots (item 1)

Ladder v per time quintile, from ws_v_w0/v_uncertainty.json. The column-duration route moves the same way (ws_v_w0): a real gas change after a short flush.

Column duration: longer in the middle on most chambers, but X and Y of one column disagree

6

Details

See the bow note, slide 10: the X–Y disagreement is larger than the 1–2 mm a dish would add, so this map is not used as evidence or as a correction.

Gain from charge: ±20–40 % across a chamber, the same in both views, det4 striped

Median fitted track charge per unit path length per 70 mm cell, X view (top) and Y view, saturated tracks included

NOT used in reconstructiongainmap.npz is loaded but all 1.0 in every promoted bundle

7

Details

Median of q_sum·cosθ over M3-matched fitted tracks. Saturation (16–69 % of tracks, F15) caps the bright end, so this compresses real gain differences. It is a proxy, not a calibration. X and Y read one avalanche, so the two rows should agree (F15: equal to ±2 %).

Connector gains (X vs Y): equal to ±2–5 %, so nothing to correct

ln(qx/qy) = c + a[X connector] − b[Y connector], M3-matched unsaturated single tracks (ws_dead_charge F15)

NOT used in reconstructionapplying them moves the charge-balance width by ≤ 0.004
